Nonprofit density per capita, overall and by size

Source: R/count-metrics.R
get_density_per_capita.Rd

Counts organizations in each market and divides by population. When a resource column is given, it also counts small and large organizations. Every market in pop_table appears in every subsector, with zero counts where it has no organizations.

Usage

get_density_per_capita(
  df,
  geography = "CENSUS_CBSA_FIPS",
  subsector = "NTEEV2",
  year = "TAXYEAR",
  pop_table,
  resource = NULL,
  small_max = 1e+05,
  large_min = 1e+07,
  per = 1e+05
)

Arguments

df

A data frame with one row per organization-year.

geography

Name of the column that identifies the market's geography, such as "CENSUS_CBSA_FIPS" or "COUNTY_FIPS".

subsector

Name of the column that identifies the subsector. When it is "NTEEV2", the first three characters (the major group) are used.

year

Name of the column that identifies the year, such as "TAXYEAR".

pop_table

Data frame of market populations with columns GEO, YEAR and POP, for example from npc_get_population().

resource

Optional resource column used to classify organizations by size. NULL gives counts only.

small_max

Organizations with a resource value below this are "small". The default is $100,000.

large_min

Organizations with a resource value at or above this are "large". The default is $10 million.

per

Population base for the rates (default 100,000).

Value

A tibble with GEO, SUB, YEAR, POP, N and DENSITY_PER_100K. With a resource, it also has N_RES (organizations with a non-missing value), N_SMALL, N_LARGE, SMALL_DENSITY_PER_100K, LARGE_DENSITY_PER_100K, SMALL_SHARE and LARGE_SHARE (shares of N_RES). Rows with GEO = "ALL" are national; their POP is the summed population of the markets in pop_table. Markets that have organizations but are missing from pop_table are kept with POP = NA.

Details

The column suffix stays _PER_100K for any per; the per value is stored in the "per" attribute.

Examples

d <- get_density_per_capita( npo_panel_sample, geography = "COUNTY_FIPS",
                             year = "TAXYEAR",
                             pop_table = npc_get_population( "county", 2015:2019 ),
                             resource = "TOTREV" )
head( d[ d$SUB == "ALL", ] )
#> # A tibble: 6 × 13
#>   GEO   SUB    YEAR     POP     N N_RES N_SMALL N_LARGE DENSITY_PER_100K
#>   <chr> <chr> <dbl>   <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>   <dbl>   <dbl>            <dbl>
#> 1 01001 ALL    2015  56688      0     0       0       0                0
#> 2 01001 ALL    2016  57111.     0     0       0       0                0
#> 3 01001 ALL    2017  57535.     0     0       0       0                0
#> 4 01001 ALL    2018  57958.     0     0       0       0                0
#> 5 01001 ALL    2019  58382.     0     0       0       0                0
#> 6 01003 ALL    2015 207016      0     0       0       0                0
#> # ℹ 4 more variables: SMALL_DENSITY_PER_100K <dbl>,
#> #   LARGE_DENSITY_PER_100K <dbl>, SMALL_SHARE <dbl>, LARGE_SHARE <dbl>
